card.name: Asterisks and WARNING headers
card.fires_on: Marker symbols such as * or ** that start a footnote or list item, the word WARNING opening a boxed warning after a section reference, and the period in section numbers like (5.2).

modes.label: Asterisk markers
modes.description: A star or double star used as a footnote or list-item marker, often after a list entry or table value.

modes.label: WARNING header
modes.description: The word WARNING starting an all-caps boxed warning right after a bracketed Warnings and Precautions reference.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.8 )] .<< WARNING>>: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREAT

modes.label: Section number period
modes.description: The period inside a section cross-reference such as 5.2 or 5.3.
modes.example: until they know how they respond to guanfacine extended-release tablets ( 5<<.>>2 )

card.writes: It promotes words meaning key or most important, which suggests it flags emphasis.
card.plain: It fires on emphasis marks like asterisks and WARNING headers, which point to key notes.
